mode.manual: CURRENT - preserved byte-for-byte; router inert/observability only
mode.assisted: FUTURE - DevBridge recommends model/cost/reasoning/budget/fallback; human executes; enabled after DB-M19 G3 dry-run gate

design.capabilityBasedRouting: TaskProfile (TaskType, RequiresCoding, Complexity, Risk, ContextRequirement, CostLimit, LatencyPreference, ReasoningLevel) -> filter eligible models -> score (quality-adjusted cost, success likelihood, latency) -> choose + fallback chain -> cost estimate -> budget verdict. NO if-model==provider-name branching; policy is config data.
design.attemptSchemaV1: TaskId, MilestoneId, WorkItemId, ChangeId, AttemptId, Provider, Model, Gateway, ReasoningLevel, TaskType, Complexity, Risk, StartedAt, EndedAt, Duration, InputTokens, CachedInputTokens, OutputTokens, EstimatedCost, ActualCost, Currency, ExchangeRate, Result, VerificationResult, FailureCategory, EscalatedFrom, EscalatedTo, RetryNumber, HumanIntervention, ContextTokens, FilesChanged, TestsPassed, TestsFailed
design.attemptPersistence: JSON records only: logs/tasks/<node>/<change>/attempts/<AttemptId>.json + state/attempts/<changeId>/; NO DB migrations
design.pricingSchemaV1: Provider, Model, Currency, EffectiveFromUtc, EffectiveToUtc, ProcessingTier, TimeBand, Input, CachedInput, CacheWrite, Output, Reasoning, ToolCalls, Images, Audio, Storage, Source, VerifiedAt
design.pricingPersistence: config/pricing/*.json data files; rates are data, never hard-coded into business logic
routerIntegrationPoints: model execution (manual/assisted: human launcher; auto: provider)
